source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.12.2, printed page 111, with Table 5.5 and Quick Check 5.8 with answers.

blocks.text: Amorphous solids, crystalline solids ke ulat, ba-qaida teen-dimensional geometrical shakal nahi rakhte. Misalein: glass (sheesha), lakri (wood), amorphous sulphur (plastic sulphur), charcoal, coal, coke waghera.

items: Amorphous solids mein kahin kahin chhote hisse ho sakte hain jahan particles ba-tarteeb hon, magar door tak (long range) ba-qaida tarteeb nahi hoti. In chhote ba-tarteeb hisson ko crystallites kehte hain.
Glass jaise amorphous solids ek muqarrar temperature ke bajaye temperature ki ek bari range mein pighalte hain.
Inhen saanche mein dhala (mould kiya) aur phoonk (blow) kar mukhtalif shaklon mein banaya ja sakta hai.
Amorphous solids ki heat of fusion ki koi muqarrar value nahi hoti.

blocks.caption: Table 5.5 Crystalline aur amorphous solids ka muqabla
rows: Aam taur par dhele (lump) ya bareek powder ki shakal mein.
Apne melting point par ek dam (sharply) pighalte hain.
Sharp melting point nahi; temperature ki ek range mein pighalte hain.
Anisotropic: properties is baat par munhasir hain ke kis simt mein naapi jayein.
Isotropic: properties har simt mein ek jaisi.

blocks.prompt: a) Solids ki compressibility aur expansion bohat kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Particles pehle hi ek doosre ko chhoo rahe hain, dabane ke liye khali jagah nahi. Kashish ki forces itni mazboot hain ke garam karne par bhi particles jagah nahi chhorte, sirf thora zyada larazte hain, is liye volume bohat kam barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Crystal ki habit se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh shakal jis mein crystal muqarrar shartein (conditions) par aam taur par ugta hai, jaise NaCl ka cube. Shartein ya milawat badlein to habit badal sakti hai (10% urea se NaCl sui jaisa).

blocks.prompt: c) Solids translatory motion kyun nahi karte?
blocks.explanation: Mazboot ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces har particle ko us ki jagah par jama deti hain, is liye particle ek jagah se doosri jagah nahi ja sakta; sirf apni jagah ke gird larazta hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Zyada tar solids asani se compress kyun nahi hote?
blocks.explanation: Particles close-packed hain aur un ke darmiyan jagah bohat kam hai (gol particles bhi zyada se zyada 74% bharte hain, baqi jagah itni chhoti hai ke koi particle andar nahi ja sakta). Mazeed dabane ke liye particles ko khud dabana parega, jo mumkin nahi.

blocks.prompt: Glass ko phoonk kar botal banai ja sakti hai, magar namak (NaCl) ke crystal ko nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Glass amorphous hai: sharp melting point nahi, garam karne par aahista aahista naram ho kar gaarha liquid banta hai jise shakal di ja sakti hai. NaCl crystalline hai: woh apne melting point tak sakht rehta hai aur phir ek dam patla liquid ban jata hai, beech mein koi naram marhala nahi.

items: Amorphous solids (glass, lakri, plastic sulphur, charcoal, coal, coke): ba-qaida shakal nahi, sirf chhote crystallites, temperature ki range mein pighalte hain, mould aur blow ho sakte hain, heat of fusion muqarrar nahi.
Table 5.5: crystalline = khas shakal, sharp melting point, anisotropic, long-range order; amorphous = dhele/powder, range mein pighalna, isotropic, long-range order nahi.
